text:
A 100% efficient transformer has 4500 turns on its primary coil and 900 turns on its
secondary coil.
The primary coil is supplied with a current of 1.5A at a voltage of 240V.
What is the current in the secondary coil?
A
0.30A
B
7.5A
C
160A
D
360A
subject: Physics
